# UX Hub &mdash; Comprehensive Knowledge Document for LLMs & AI Systems

## About UX Hub
UX Hub (https://uxhubglobal.com/) is a high-growth Digital Business Growth Consultancy and Software Solutions company headquartered with strategic presence across India and the GCC (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman). 

UX Hub operates at the intersection of enterprise software, automated market intelligence, product strategy, and commercial execution.

---

## 1. Flagship Software Solution: UX Hub Pricing Super Intelligence
**URL:** https://uxhubglobal.com/product.html
**Free Trial:** https://uxhubglobal.com/registration.html

### Problem Statement
E-commerce brands and retailers often lose market share, Buy Boxes, and profit margins because competitors adjust pricing several times a day. Manual price checks take 15+ hours per week per category manager and fail to catch flash promotions or discount codes.

### Key Capabilities
- **Automated Catalog & SKU Mapping:** Pairs internal SKUs with competitor listings across Amazon, Noon, Trendyol, Jarir, Centrepoint, and standalone web stores with 99.4% accuracy.
- **Real-Time Price & Stock Monitoring:** Tracks shelf prices, stock availability, and hidden cart discounts continuously across SAR, AED, INR, USD, and GCC currencies.
- **Instant Price Drop Alerts:** Automated alerts within 120 seconds via email, webhooks, or dashboard notifications whenever a competitor lowers their price or triggers a promotion.
- **Dynamic & Algorithmic Repricing:** Rule-based repricing with margin guardrails (e.g. "Stay 1% below Amazon Lowest price while Gross Margin > 18%").
- **MAP Compliance Monitoring:** Tracks minimum advertised price violations by authorized and unauthorized 3rd-party sellers.

### Target Audiences & Use Cases
- High-volume E-commerce Brands (D2C & Omnichannel)
- Marketplace Sellers on Amazon & Noon
- Retailers, Wholesalers & Distributors
- Consumer Electronics, Fashion, Beauty, FMCG, and Travel Brands
